assurance_review.evidence_question: How should a conflicting source be handled before the disposition is recorded?
assurance_review.source_facts: service owner retained contract evidence for this review.
assurance_review.counterexample: A single approval cannot settle a conflicting record; the discrepancy must remain visible to the reviewer.
assurance_review.review_observation: the record explained the relationship between policy and practice
assurance_review.challenge_performed: a control objective was tested for a measurable outcome
assurance_review.review_profile: ['the evidence set was collected before the approval meeting', 'the accountable owner confirmed the operating boundary', 'the reviewer sampled an adverse operating condition', 'the source fact supported acceptance without qualification', 'the comparison used the current control objective', 'the evidence was retained in the review register', 'the exception path was considered and recorded', 'the reviewer found no handover impact', 'the decision was suitable for targeted follow-up', 'the source chronology contained a reconciled late entry', 'the control claim was independently corroborated', 'the review boundary excluded unavailable material', 'the next assurance trigger is completion of the follow-up action', 'the disposition was communicated to the owner', 'the retained rationale supports repeat review', 'the record remains a local offline assurance artifact']
assurance_review.decision_rule: Record an approval only after the reviewer can reproduce the conclusion from the retained facts without network access.
assurance_review.disposition: escalated for corroboration with the decision basis retained
assurance_review.operating_boundary: No Kio capability is used or required for this offline review.
